Name: New Crops - Mythical Flowers
Author: lunightmare
Description:
This mod will add eight new crops for your game, which are some cute flowers!
All of them take five days to fully grow, having four steps of growth.
There are two crops per season:

[b]SPRING:
[/b]· Pink
· White
[b]SUMMER:
[/b]· Red
· Green
[b]AUTUMN:
[/b]· Orange
· Purple
[b]WINTER:
[/b]· Blue
· Iced (A special one)

[b][size=3]!! In order to make the winter flowers work, you'll need Spacecore!![/size]


[size=5][i]DOWNLOAD INSTRUCTIONS

[/i][/size][size=3]· Download the mod in "Files".[/size]
[b][size=3]· Once downloaded, extract de zip file, it has a folder inside with the name of the mod.
[b][size=3]· Place it in your "Mods" folder, located in your Stardew Valley folder.[/size][/b][/size]
[/b][b][size=3]· Run your game through SMAPI.
[/size][b][size=3]· Have fun![/size][/b]
[/b]

[/b]I'll probably be upaditng, so any requests will be read and answered
